outcome: Prenatal diagnosis rate of vasa previa
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of vasa previa by transvaginal sonography was achieved in all cases, leading to a high rate of cesarean deliveries and no perinatal deaths.
mod_finding: Seven out of eight deliveries (87.5%) were performed via cesarean section due to vasa previa, while one delivery occurred vaginally at 33 weeks of gestation in a twin pregnancy.
gest_age: 26 weeks (mean gestational age at diagnosis), 37 weeks (mean gestational age at delivery)
